404.title: Page Not Found
404.message: We couldn't find the page you're looking for. The address may be incorrect, outdated, or the page may have been moved. Check the URL you entered or go back home.

423.title: Locked
423.message: This resource is currently locked and cannot be processed.

429.title: Too Many Requests
429.message: Too many requests were sent in a short period of time. Wait a moment and try again.

500.title: Internal Server Error
500.message: A server error prevented your request from being processed. If the problem persists, please contact me.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.message: The service is temporarily unavailable due to server load or maintenance. Please try again in a few minutes.
